en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a church tower with a clock, attached to a multi‑storey structure, next to a rectory-style house and a small war memorial in a cobbled square with trimmed trees. The printed caption in German at the top identifies the scene as the church, parsonage and war memorial in Königsbrück. Printer information appears vertically on the left margin.
